title: Frackworm
definition: The Frackworm is a colossal segmented boring worm of Endessa, generated by the Syndicate's stolen prototype Generator to work the Nightcap wells. It bores through the dune particulate to the old ocean-floor substrate and forces a pressurized slurry into the seams until the substrate fractures, and it still does that work in the cavern networks for the Xalians who kept drilling after the Nightcap Barons died.
